description: This file defines functions related to quiz management in a flashcard application, including quiz generation, submission, and result retrieval. It interacts with a database to fetch flashcards, create quizzes, store attempts, and record review logs.

methods.name: generateQuiz(userId, { size = 10, categoryId = null, direction = 'en_to_id' })
methods.description: Generates a quiz for a user by selecting due flashcards and creating multiple-choice questions with distractors, and stores the quiz and questions in the database.

methods.name: submitQuiz(userId, quizId, { responses })
methods.description: Processes user responses to a quiz, updates attempt records, records review logs, and marks the quiz as completed.

methods.name: quizResults(userId, quizId)
methods.description: Retrieves the results of a completed quiz, including attempts and overall correctness.

ctags.name: generateQuiz
ctags.pattern: /^async function generateQuiz(userId, { size = 10, categoryId = null, direction = 'en_to_id' }) {$/
